A little letter

For you, from me.

Dear ,

It’s almost our first year together. I still can’t believe it’s been almost a whole year since you became mine.

On our first date, I could tell you were nervous. So was I, pero tinatry kong hindi magpakain sa nervousness so that I wouldn’t mess it up. When I held your hand, my heart skipped a beat. Cliché, but it really did. I couldn’t see or hear the people around us. It felt like we were the only ones in Gateway, kahit sa labas lang tayo ng Pepper Lunch kumain. Kunwari pa akong na-aamaze sa liit ng kamay mo, pero gusto ko lang talagang makahanap ng reason para tumagal yung paghawak ko sa kamay mo. HEHEHE

You always ask me kung nabobore ako kasi paulit-ulit lang ginagawa natin, and I always say hindi. To be honest, mas nahihiya nga ako, kasi madalas ikaw na ang gumagawa ng gawaing bahay natin, tapos ikaw pa ang nagpo-provide. I hope hindi ka mapagod sa akin.

Thank you for loving my family like they’re your own. I love your family too, because they are all good people. Sana kapag may sarili na tayong pamilya, mapalaki natin ang babies natin to be good people too.

I love you, Jaya. Sobrang love, and that will never ever change. It’ll only grow more.

I can’t wait to marry you and to call you my misis. ;)

Love always,
